Name: Forever Winter
Author: WidowStar
Description:
Changes every (or most) vanilla maps in the game to make it be winter forever. Some things are not modified (such as tilled dirt) to see the current season in those.

Also has an optional download to change all of the seasonal music to play winter's music as well.

Downloads.Description: Optional download to make all seasonal music become Winter Music
